intro: Identify a writer’s view, supporting reasons, a concession and a response.
b1.titulo: Separate the view from its support
b1.texto: A forum post may state a view, give a reason, acknowledge a drawback and suggest a response. Connectors help you follow the relationship: **aunque** introduces a concession; **sin embargo** marks contrast; **por eso** introduces a consequence. A reason is not automatically evidence: notice whether the writer gives an example, a source or only a personal impression.
b2.f0: Lucía: In my neighbourhood they have reduced parking spaces to widen the pavements. At first I was annoyed because I often drive my father to medical appointments.
b2.f1: However, there is now a short-stay drop-off area and it is easier to walk with a wheelchair. It is an improvement, although they should make sure the area is not occupied for hours.
b2.f2: Raúl: I agree that pavements should be accessible, but I do not think removing parking spaces alone will solve traffic. My proposal is for the bus to run more often, so that some people can leave the car at home.
b2.f3: To make a decision, the council should publish data on how the area is used and consult the people who live there.
b2.f4: Lucía replies that, on the one hand, accessibility benefits the whole neighbourhood; on the other, it is necessary to check whether the loading area is respected.
b4.pregunta: What is Lucía’s overall view of the change?
